metadata.description: Legal Database with IPC sections and U.S. Federal Law citations

citations.title: Murder
citations.text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
citations.description: Punishment for murder - death or life imprisonment

citations.title: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder
citations.text: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
citations.description: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder

citations.title: Grievous Hurt
citations.text: Grievous hurt is whoever causes permanent injury, causes any permanent loss of sight or hearing, leaves person disfigured, or causes any ailment that endangers life.
citations.description: Definition of grievous hurt - permanent injury

citations.title: Acts Done by Several Persons in Furtherance of Common Intention
citations.text: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each of such persons is liable for that act in the same manner as if it were done by him alone.

citations.title: Good Faith
citations.text: Nothing is an offence done by a person who is bound by law to do it, or by mistake of fact believing himself bound by such law.

citations.title: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
citations.text: Whoever cheats and thereby induces the person deceived to deliver any property, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.

citations.title: Rape
citations.text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of not less than seven years, which may extend to life, and shall also be liable to fine.

citations.title: Theft
citations.text: Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of a person without that person's consent, moves that property, commits theft.

citations.title: Criminal Breach of Trust
citations.text: Whoever, being in any manner entrusted with property, or with any dominion over property, dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use, shall be punished.

citations.title: Criminal Trespass
citations.text: Whoever enters into or upon property in the possession of another with intent to commit an offence, or to intimidate, insult or annoy any person, commits criminal trespass.

citations.title: Husband or Relative of Husband Subjecting Wife to Cruelty
citations.text: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.

citations.title: Definitions
citations.text: As used in this title, the term 'person' includes any individual, corporation, company, association, firm, partnership, society, or joint stock company.

citations.title: False Statements to Healthcare Matters
citations.text: Whoever, in any matter involving a health care benefit program, knowingly and willfully falsifies or conceals a material fact, shall be fined or imprisoned up to 5 years.

citations.title: Mail Fraud
citations.text: Whoever, having devised or intending to devise any scheme or artifice to defraud, uses the mail for the execution of such scheme, shall be fined and imprisoned up to 20 years.

citations.title: Fraud by Wire, Radio, or Television
citations.text: Whoever, having devised or intending to devise a scheme to defraud, transmits or causes to be transmitted by wire, radio, or television in interstate commerce, shall be fined and imprisoned.

citations.title: Money Laundering
citations.text: Whoever knowingly conducts or attempts to conduct a financial transaction knowing the property involved represents proceeds of unlawful activity, shall be fined.

citations.title: Racketeering
citations.text: The term 'racketeering activity' means any act or threat involving murder, kidnapping, gambling, arson, robbery, bribery, extortion, or dealing in narcotic drugs.

citations.title: Controlled Substances
citations.text: It is unlawful for any person to knowingly or intentionally manufacture, distribute, or dispense a controlled substance.

citations.title: Tax Evasion
citations.text: Any person who willfully attempts to evade or defeat any tax shall be guilty of a felony and fined up to $100,000.

citations.title: Civil Action for Deprivation of Rights
citations.text: Every person who, under color of law, subjects any person to the deprivation of rights, shall be liable in a civil action.
